title: Taking Vic to see Ice age 3...WHOOOOOOOOOP....

posts.body:
Vic and i are having Mummy and Vic day today and he wants to go see ice age 3,i think im more excited than him lol.We are leaving Samuel with my mum so it will be just us two (justin is at work). Vic is so excited as we hardly do anything just the two of us!!
Tomorow its Vic and Justins day out alone then during the week we are having a few family days (justin is finally taking a few days off 😀 ). Vic wants to go to the museum and the observitorium(sp)where you look at the stars,moon etc???We were going to go to the Zoo as well but its so cold and raining.Im so sad that the school holidays are coming to an end at least next holidays the weather should be nicer and we can get out a bit more.

I went yesterday to the 3D version and it was really good- very funny.
Enjoy your Mummy and Victor day 😀
Ice age three isn't at Aber yet, our cinema wont have it for ages yet! My sister is coming to visit, not going to tell her she is going to be stuck with Pippa or Ash yet  😀

😀 It was awsome (apart from the stomache ache we both got later on from all the junk food lol).
Alex we also wanted to see the 3d version but they dont do it at the cinema near my place and the cinema in the city is always packed out in the holidays.
We are of to the circus this weekend. Vic has never been and the last time i went i was 15 "long time ago i know" 😊 lol.Justin has mixed feelings he wants to go but hates the idea that lions,tigers etc are caged up for entertainment 🤔

We are going to the Moscow State circus on tht 27th July. Do you still have animals in circus over there?  They were banned here (although I think they are maybe allowed certain ones again- i.e horses)

I know dogs and horses are allowed here, but you have to get a new certificate every so often to make sure the animals are healthy and not being abused. We wont take ours to any circus that has animals.
This one has lions and tigers and im pretty sure i saw an elephant on the leaflet??
glad you enjoyed it  😀  i took catherine to see it last weekend. brilliant film  😀
